extraction.policy_summary: Linde India states it has an Equal Opportunity Policy as per the RPwD Act, 2016, mapped to Principle 3 in its policy list; the web-link provided points to the Company's Code of Business Integrity document.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: The filing explicitly reports zero (Nil) differently-abled employees and zero differently-abled workers (both permanent and other-than-permanent categories) as of FY2025-26, out of a total workforce of 1,696 employees and 723 workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The Company states it has a 'disabled employee and worker friendly Head Office' and has provided similar infrastructure at other locations 'wherever such modifications were practically possible,' and commits to implementing disabled-person-friendly structures in new infrastructure from the outset.
extraction.compliance_details: The Company states its premises are being made accessible per the RPwD Act, 2016, and confirms it has an equal opportunity policy per the RPwD Act, 2016. No specific RPwD Act employment-quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is disclosed; notably, the company reports zero PwD employees/workers on its own headcount table.
